analysis_steps.goal: Measure image fluxes and flux limit of central image

method.value: Fluxes in regions A-E from CO and continuum maps; uncertainty is rms times sqrt(number of beams)

method.value: Two cored elliptical power-law profiles with shared centroid fit to 87x87 pixel region excluding lensed images; with and without point source

evidence.quote: We fit the lens light with the sum of two cored elliptical power-law profiles
The double power-law plus point source fit has $\chi^{2} \approx 1500$ in F110W and $\chi^{2} \approx 2300$ in F160W

validation.value: Compared with Sersic and double Sersic fits and both bands

evidence.quote: We test a Sérsic profile fit, but find that it is disfavored in the fitting region

analysis_steps.goal: Fit lens mass models to image positions

method.value: Cored power-law (R_core 0.08'' or 0.15'' priors) and composite stellar+NFW models, plus SMBH point mass and external shear, using positions of three source features

evidence.quote: We try two models for the mass distribution of the lens galaxy: a cored elliptical power-law mass distribution, and a composite model with separate stellar and dark matter components.
we first sample $L_{\rm pos}\times Q$ via MCMC of chain length $5\times10^5$, and then weight these samples by $L_{\rm flux}$
